channel.title: CNN 5 Things
channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: Split Ticket Voters: The Mood in Michigan
item.itunes:title: Split Ticket Voters: The Mood in Michigan
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Election Day voting is underway across the country, with control of the House and Senate on the line. We check in on a polling place in Michigan, where some voters are splitting their ticket amid Democratic drama in the key Senate race.

--- 

Guest: Sunlen Serfaty, CNN Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Nicky Robertson

item.title: How Do You Plan Against Election Threats from...the Federal Government?
item.itunes:title: How Do You Plan Against Election Threats from...the Federal Government?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Election officials across the country have been preparing for every possible disruption ahead of Election Day – including meddling from the Trump administration. With just hours to go before polls open, we examine the mood amongst officials and how they are training their workers to interact with federal poll monitors.

--- 

Guest: Gabe Cohen, CNN Correspondent 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Maddie Marshall, Marshall Cohen
